name: precise-number
title: Precise Number
description: Compact number display (₹1.2 Cr, $1.2M) that cuts instead of rounding up, puts the exact value in a tooltip that isn't clipped by tables or scroll areas, gives spoken units, offers a lakh/crore toggle that rolls the figure to its new units, and keeps percentages honest.

meta.summary: Shows big numbers compactly (₹1.2 Cr, $1.2M) without ever rounding up, with the exact value one hover or focus away.
catches: ₹99,99,999 shown as ₹1 Cr: it reads ₹99.9 L instead
Exact value hidden: tooltip on hover or focus
Lakh/crore vs million confusion, with a toggle
limits: Display only; it doesn't parse input
Cutting means the compact figure can be slightly low; the tooltip is the exact value
a11y: Approximate values are focusable and described by the exact-value tooltip
Spoken units are given as text for screen readers
Toggle has an aria-label naming the system it switches to
Roll animation is skipped under reduced motion
